speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have progressive swelling and pain in your right ring finger; can you tell me how long these symptoms have been present and if you have noticed any redness or warmth?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old male. The patient reports that the pain and swelling in his right ring finger began 2 days ago while playing football. He recalls his finger got caught in the jersey of another player, who then pulled away forcefully.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Traumatic Flexor Tenosynovitis (or potential early Septic Arthritis).

Given the mechanism of injury (jersey grab and pull) and the rapid onset of swelling and pain, I need to know if you have lost any finger movement, specifically the ability to fully straighten or flex the finger, and if you have developed a fever or chills.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
